sentences.en: The morning forecast predicted thunder showers later in the day.
sentences.zh: 早上的预报下午可能会有雷阵雨。

sentences.en: The long-range forecast says we will have a mild winter.
sentences.zh: 长期预报显示这个冬天会比较温和。

sentences.en: The weather forecast predicts whether it will rain or not.
sentences.zh: 天气预报预测今天是否会下雨。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：fore（预先）+cast（扔）→预先扔出（消息）→预测
